title: integration: wire all handlers, cargo test --workspace, lock crate
description:
Final integration pass: wire all handler modules into lib.rs, run full test suite, lock crate in AGENTS.md.

## Steps

1. Fill in all 26 method registrations in register_mail_handlers with real handler functions (replacing stubs)
2. Run cargo test --workspace — all tests must pass
3. Run cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings — zero warnings
4. Run RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps — zero warnings
5. Run cargo fmt --all — no changes needed
6. Add jmap-mail-server to locked crates table in ~/PROJECT/JMAP/AGENTS.md
7. Add lock section to ~/PROJECT/JMAP/crate-jmap-mail-server/CLAUDE.md (same format as jmap-server AGENTS.md lock section)

## Acceptance criteria
- cargo test --workspace passes (all crates, all tests)
- All 26 methods registered and functional (no serverFail stubs remaining)
- Integration tests cover all object types with at least the non-trivial cases listed in PLAN.md §Test Strategy
- Crate locked in both workspace AGENTS.md and crate-level CLAUDE.md
- git status shows no untracked files (PLAN.md is the only new file; it should already be committed)

## Non-trivial integration test cases (from PLAN.md)
- Mailbox/set destroy with onDestroyRemoveEmails propagation
- Email/set thread assignment via In-Reply-To header
- Email/changes updatedProperties when only keywords changed
- ResultReference from Email/query into Email/get ($list pattern)
- EmailSubmission/set onSuccessUpdateEmail removes \Draft
- VacationResponse singleton enforcement
- SearchSnippet capability gating
- Email/import thread assignment from References header
- Mailbox role uniqueness (two Inboxes rejected)
- Email/copy cross-account with onSuccessDestroyOriginal
- Identity/set destroy default identity forbidden
- Email/set immutable field update rejected
